settling_timing_check.method: Saved full maps every5ps; consecutive200ps windows sampled on a200ps endpoint grid; density spans/drifts<0.5%, density maps<1%, Stokes maps/S0<1%. Approximate acceptance times, not certified relaxation constants; common field-phase error not included in these separate timing labels.
settling_timing_check.interpretation: No universal phase-after-density ordering. A0/A1 have J=beta=0: distinct component frequencies can support ongoing relative-phase rotation even at stationary densities. Do not wait for phase locking as the only accepted outcome.

full_map_cycle_recheck.method: Two original >=5-period windows; same periods/recurrence tolerances. Compare pointwise full-map RMS oscillation amplitudes (not spatially cancelling integrals) over5 complete cycles, and cycle means. Map channels stationary within the original1% criterion are reported as stationary, not tested for a nonzero relative oscillation amplitude. Original classifier flags and all run data remain unchanged.
